'''Thothash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and a member of the [[Cult of Ki Sazen]], a Nikto cult that worshiped the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]].
